noticias.titulo: S&P 500 Earnings Expected to Rise 31% in Q3 as AI-Related Companies Lead Growth
noticias.resumo:
Analysts forecast that earnings among S&P 500 companies will rise approximately 31% year over year, with the technology sector and AI-related companies, including Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOG), Amazon. com (NASDAQ:AMZN) and Meta Platforms (NASDAQ:META), contributing around two-thirds of the increase. 

Tajinder Dhillon, LSEG's head of earnings and equity research, said the concentration of earnings growth among these companies reflects the continued influence of AI-related investment on corporate profitability.

noticias.titulo: AI and Technology Expected to Drive Two-Thirds of S&P 500 Earnings Growth in Q3
noticias.resumo:
Nick Raich, chief executive of Earnings Scout, said upward revisions to earnings forecasts are beginning to slow, although AI infrastructure investment continues at a substantial pace. 

Raich cited recent results from Micron Technology (NASDAQ:MU) as an indication that companies supplying AI-related infrastructure continue to receive orders and investment commitments. 

Micron last month issued a quarterly revenue forecast above market expectations and reported that customer commitments under long-term supply agreements had reached $32 billion.
